fleet: warm repeat; eight workers approximately64 sandboxes each; 12402656/657/658/659/660/661/662/682
interpretation: Largest observed tail is after durable placement command completion, before relay wake acknowledgment. These stages alone cannot distinguish gateway result polling/socket delivery from relay completion transaction scheduling.
query: WITH timings AS (SELECT extract(epoch from c.created_at)-r.completed_at AS before_queue, extract(epoch from c.completed_at-c.created_at) AS in_queue, r.wake_notified_at-extract(epoch from c.completed_at) AS after_queue FROM gateway_commands c JOIN ucloud_shared.relay_requests r ON r.request_id=convert_from(c.body,'UTF8')::jsonb->>'request_id' WHERE c.kind='wake' AND c.sandbox_id LIKE 'relay-load-1c19030665c7-%' AND c.state='done' AND r.wake_notified_at IS NOT NULL) SELECT count(*),percentile_cont(.5) within group(order by before_queue),percentile_cont(.95) within group(order by before_queue),percentile_cont(.5) within group(order by in_queue),percentile_cont(.95) within group(order by in_queue),percentile_cont(.5) within group(order by after_queue),percentile_cont(.95) within group(order by after_queue),max(before_queue),max(after_queue) FROM timings
